notes.title: Blasphemous: The Board Game reopens its gates!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35061675/f5e8fb601f153f4a1c481f99847b4527702d1c93.jpg[/img]

It’s been two months since the campaign ended, and we couldn’t be more grateful. [b]5664
backers[/b] joined us to bring this project to life, and many more people have shown interest
and support along the way. Truly, thank you for being a part of this!

But this isn’t the end…

[h2]Pledge Manager and Late Pledge are Live![/h2]

The [b][url=https://gamefound.com/en/projects/lms/blasphemous-the-boardgame]Pledge Manager[/url][/b] is officially open! This allows you to finalize your orders, calculate
shipping costs, and if you're interested in the crowdfunding campaign, [b]join this epic
adventure thanks to the possibility of making a Late Pledge[/b], and get almost everything
that backers unlocked during the campaign.

Join now before silence falls upon Cvstodia once again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35061675/e987ab453a3e53efea5839e1ff6ccb56f8f17045.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Core Game box art[/h3]

We decided with Ludus Magnus to give the board game a brand new box art. We all wanted
an image that better represented the spirit of the board game and its contents, so Ludus
Magnus hired the internationally renowned artist [b]Antonio De Luca[/b] to create it, and the final
result is amazing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35061675/4056b3a5e4427daad0d18dc5a4aef2aaf7157209.png[/img]

Everything you need to know will be on [b][url=https://gamefound.com/en/projects/lms/blasphemous-the-boardgame/updates]Ludus Magnus Gamefound page[/url][/b] —so spread the
word and invite your friends to follow the project! Cvstodia has reopened its gates, and it
awaits you all!

notes.title: The Balance and True Torment Patch is Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43984560/3a98d177cf371e627ef4ad27dfb974524f1f8b14.png[/img]

[h2]Greetings Sinners! It is truly a most blessed day, as the [b]Balance and True Torment Patch[/b] has arrived! Thank you for your patience whilst we've worked on this patch![/h2]

The main focus of this patch is adjusting the way that the [b]True Torment Mode[/b] works. Ascending your save file and starting again will let you keep your weapons (including Mea Culpa), Figures, Prayers, Rosary Beads (with minimal exceptions) and a small number of other items. This will only work on saves that are Ascended after the new update. Existing saves will instead be updated to automatically include the new [b]Ultimate Torment[/b] challenge.

[b]Ultimate Torment[/b] is a new challenge that is selectable when you Ascend your save. Selecting it will remove your weapons, Figures, Prayers and Rosary Beads, as it did by default before the update. This challenge cannot be turned off midway through your playthrough, so choose carefully!

We have also added further file selection options when you Ascend a save, so that you are less likely to delete your save data.

As we have changed the way that [b]True Torment[/b] works, we have significantly rebalanced enemies, bosses and individual challenges when playing on an Ascended save.

[h3]Here are the other bugfixes and adjustments introduced in this patch:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed a softlock that triggered when the player would try to hand in more Lumps of Gold than was required
[*] Fixed an issue where the player would sometimes receive damage multiple times from one source
[*] Fixed an issue where defeating certain bosses and dying at the same time would cause softlocks
[*] Adjusted the hitbox of several bosses to better reflect their visual attacks
[*] Fixed some typos and mistranslations in Chinese languages
[*] Fixed an issue where the Consummate Collector achievement would not trigger when it should do in certain circumstances
[*] Adjusted the text for the Consummate Collector achievement to better explain how to obtain it
[*] Fixed a crash on Steam Deck when viewing the tutorial videos for the Mea Culpa
[*] Fixed an issue where the Golden Bile Flask would not work as expected on an Ascended save
[*] Fixed an issue with The Flagellant’s effects not happening straight away
[*] Fixed some overlapping issues with the Dyslexia font
[*] Fixed an issue where hitting a Bell of Resonance would not trigger its effect in some instances
[*] Fixed an issue with the Cherub counter not updating as it should do
[*] Fixed an issue where True Torment challenges would sometimes not save their difficulty values
[*] Fixed an issue where the Lump of Gold tracker image would stay on the screen if you teleported away whilst it was displayed
[*] Fixed and adjusted numerous damage values with all weapons
[*] Fixed an issue where the Silver Nail could trigger earlier than intended
[*] Fixed an issue where you could “float/hover” using Mea Culpa’s abilities
[*] Fixed an issue where the players could sometimes escape the map in certain areas
[*] Fixed a consistency issue with Martinete of Forge and Thunder
[*] Fixed an issue where opening the map after loading a save file would sometimes cause the player to lose input
[*] Fixed an issue where you would not be able to obtain your Guilt Fragment in certain rooms after dying
[*] Fixed several animation issues when triggering abilities at certain times
[*] Fixed an issue where some SFX and Music would not trigger when Ascending a save file
[*] Fixed an issue where SFX and music would not play when fighting Odon of the Brotherhood of Salt
[*] Adjusted some of the resonances so that their categories match up more appropriately and trigger as expected
[*] Fixed an issue where the Screaming Widow’s attack would stay on screen after it was defeated
[*] Fixed an issue where the cost of upgrading your Altarpiece capacity was not shown to the player
[*] Fixed an issue where the Piercing Retribution counterattack may miss the enemy
[*] Adjusted the placements of the Lamp Ghost enemy
[*] Adjusted the locations of certain options in the main menu
[*] Fixed an issue where Chisel-Engraved Wounds would emit sounds in rooms where it shouldn’t do so
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2879370/Blasphemous_2__Mea_Culpa/

notes.title: Mea Culpa Expansion | Update 1
notes.content:
Sinners!

Your patience is a virtue and will be rewarded! The first update for the Mea Culpa expansion has arrived!

Thank you for all of your feedback since the expansion's release. Player feedback, both positive and critical, has been extremely useful and has made this update possible. We hope that you'll keep sharing your thoughts with us.

Please report any additional bugs or issues to Support Team here: [url=https://www.team17.com/support]Team17 Support[/url]

This first update focuses on fixing a number of bugs that were present on release. This update is releasing on Steam first, with other platforms to follow soon.

[b]Rest assured that a design patch is also on the way soon, which will address balancing, True Torment and include more fixes![/b] We'll share more information about the design patch as soon as we can!

[h3]Here's what's included in this update:[/h3]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
 
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Gold Lumps would disappear from your inventory after dying, and subsequently block the final reward and an achievement from unlocking
[*] Fixed an issue where the player's Cherub count would not match what was collected
[*] Fixed an issue where Ruego Al Alba's Blood Pact gauge would decrease too quickly
[*] Fixed an issue where the jump button being re-binded would cause a visual issue on screen
[*] Fixed an issue where cutscenes would not play correctly for certain players
[*] Fixed issues with Asterión's animations sometimes freezing
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could soft lock in a certain room in the Elevated Temples
[*] Fixed an issue where the Screaming Widow's mark would stay on the player despite being killed, which could cause subsequent issues
[*] Fixed an issue where dying after a challenge in the Grilles and Ruin would make the reward impossible to collect
[*] Fixed an issue with Asterión's name sometimes showing as a different name
[*] Fixed an issue where the player's animation could freeze using the Holy Wrath ability
[*] Fixed an issue where certain cutscenes wouldn't stop if the game was minimised
[*] Fixed an issue where Incarnate Remorse would not work correctly
[*] Fixed an issue where the camera would freeze in rare circumstances after a battle arena
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could still be hit after a successful dodge on Eviterno, First of the Penitents
[*] Fixed respawn issues in several rooms after landing on spikes
[*] Fixed an issue where using Mirabras of the Return to Port in certain circumstances would soft lock the player
[*] Fixed an issue with the Chandelier Traps sometimes causing issues for the player
[/list]
 
[h2]Adjustments[/h2]
 
[list]
[*] Adjusted the hit boxes of Asterión to better match what would be expected from his animations
[*] Added a Gold Lump display counter when handing them in for better understanding of how many are remaining
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2879370/Blasphemous_2__Mea_Culpa/

notes.title: Blasphemous II: Mea Culpa releasing on October 31st
notes.content:
[h1]Restore the Mea Culpa on October 31st! 🙏[/h1]

[h2]Blasphemous II: Mea Culpa Expansion and Free True Torment Update Announced![/h2]

[previewyoutube=ZcRd-ghydN0;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Awaken Penitent One! Thy penance is far from over![/b]

Embark on a new quest through the forgotten pathways of Cvstodia in this new expansion for Blasphemous II! Restore the Mea Culpa, the lost sword wielded by the Penitent One in the first Blasphemous game, and continue your story!

Now is the perfect time to jump into the definitive telling of Blasphemous II's story - and experience its harshest challenges.

[h3]The Mea Culpa Expansion adds:[/h3]

📿 Two new areas
📿 Two bosses
📿 Four new quests
📿 An alternative ending for the Penitent One
📿 A new (yet familiar) weapon and ability
📿 New prayers
📿 New Rosary Beads
📿 New achievements
📿9 new OST tracks by Carlos Viola

[b]PLUS:[/b] All players will also have access to the FREE True Torment Update on October 31st. This update includes not just the highly requested [b]New Game Plus[/b] mode, but also a host of other features, including the expansion of existing zones and new zone connections, new abilities, new enemies, new prayers, Quality of Life features, accessibility features and much more!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2879370/Blasphemous_2__Mea_Culpa/

[h2]FAQ[/h2]

[b]What is Blasphemous II: Mea Culpa? [/b]
Blasphemous II Mea Culpa is a premium expansion for Blasphemous 2. The expansion’s story centres around Mea Culpa, the lost sword wielded by The Penitent One in the first game. The paid Mea Culpa expansion adds:
[list]
[*] 2 new zones 
[*] 2 bosses 
[*] 4 new quests 
[*] An alternate ending for The Penitent One 
[*] A new (yet familiar) weapon and ability 
[*] New prayers 
[*] New rosary beads 
[*] New Argent board figures 
[*] New achievements 
[/list]

[b]Is there a free update?[/b]
Blasphemous II: Mea Culpa launches alongside the FREE True Torment Update. This free update includes:
[list]
[*] Expanded zones: Choir of Thorns, Sunken Cathedral and Basilica of Ancient Faces have all been reforged with new challenges to explore and conquer.
[*] New connecting zones: Quicker traversal between zones you've already explored so you can dash your way across the world faster than Sarmiento and Centella.
[*] A new challenge: The Labyrinth of Tides presents a new challenge for those ready to face it. 
[*] New Game+: Totally adjustable difficulty options to upgrade your save game, from stronger enemies to deadlier spikes and lethal falls.
[*] New enemies: Cvstodia's denizens rise to face you, are you up to their challenge?
[*] Plus a host of upgrades for the Penitent One, Quality of Life improvements and new Achievements.
[/list]

[b]When does it release?[/b] 
The Mea Culpa Expansion and True Torment Update release on October 31st on all platforms..

[b]How much is the Mea Culpa Expansion?[/b]
The Mea Culpa Expansion is priced at £11.99 / $11.99 / €11.99 with a 20% launch discount running for two weeks from October 31st.

[b]How long is the new content?[/b]
The True Torment Update and Mea Culpa Expansion add a wealth of new content to Blasphemous II. Combined, they expand the explorable area of Blasphemous II by 40%! How long it’ll take you to complete depends on you. Players can speed through the new Mea Culpa story in 2-3 hours, or spend 6-8 hours seeing it all. True Torment content is spread throughout the base game, so how quickly you’ll find everything depends wholly on your abilities, Penitent One!

[b]Do I need to start a new game?[/b]
You do not need to start a new game to experience the Mea Culpa Expansion or the New Game Plus Update. However, players are free to start a new run or New Game Plus and experience all the new additions alongside The Penitent One’s existing journey. The choice is yours.

[b]How does True Torment (New Game Plus) work?[/b]
We're keeping this as a surprise, but True Torment (also known as New Game Plus) is a customizable and tiered experience with unlockable rewards. Once your penance is over, you will be able to upgrade it and access this new mode.

notes.title: Blasphemous II PC Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
Greetings, Sinners.

The response to this game has been absolutely overwhelming and we are deeply grateful for your support. 

We want to thank you all for your patience: The Penitent One’s slumber lasted quite a while, but we hope the wait was worth it, and that you are enjoying this second pilgrimage that we at the Game Kitchen have crafted for you.

Since the game’s release just a few weeks ago, our team has been painstakingly reading your comments, watching your videos, and listening to your feedback. And thanks to this we began shaping a patch that focuses on the most important topics.

What follows is a detailed document of the changes included. Please take into account that the following notes include [b]SPOILERS[/b]. Read them at your own risk!


[h1]Player[/h1]

[b]Player stunlock issues [/b]

[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that could lock some players in the hurt animation if they were cornered by an enemy.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused less iframes to be active after certain hits.
[*]Rebalanced some super armor periods to improve player resistance to pushback under certain conditions.
[/list]

[b]Other player issues[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the player’s weapon slots didn’t match the order seeing in the inventory menu.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player’s jump could be cancelled into a dash in the next frame after starting the dash, creating the possibility of ‘spamming’ dash related effects.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could maintain momentum after crossing an air dash barrier by casting a verse or by using certain attacks.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could cross an air dash barrier while looking to the opposite side.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could cancel a chant in unintended ways (for example: by changing the equipped weapon, interacting with ladders…).
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could not use the teleporting mirrors if they were attacked while the player was crouching.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could become stuck in a loop with teleporting mirrors.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could not use the teleporting mirrors if they were attacked while the player was finishing an air dash.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could increase the dash length by quickly opening and closing inventory.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player wouldn’t be able to attack if they switched their weapon just before changing scenes.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player wouldn’t be able to hit a Warcenser Bell again if they changed scenes just after hitting it.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player would jump or open the inventory after dismissing the map opened while talking to Anunciada for the first time.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could get softlocked if they attacked or parried just before a cutscene section where The Penitent One moves to a certain position without the player’s input.
[*] Fixed a visual bug where an unwanted VFX would be shown when attacking a mirror teleporter with 3 Verdadera Destreza charges.
[/list]

[h1]Weapons[/h1]

[h2]Veredicto[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a visual bug where the player would have Veredicto’s fire effect active with another weapon equipped.
[*] Fixed a bug where the warcenser didn’t turn off while chaining ignited attacks.
[*] Fixed a bug where warcenser Ignition Strike wasn’t being recognized under certain conditions.
[*] Fixed a bug where one of the censer effects (fire or miasma) would be present when the other one should be taking its place after changing Altarpiece pieces with the censer ignited.
[*] Reduced fervour gained by crouched spin attack.
[/list]

[h2]Sarmiento & Centella[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the player would be locked in the ‘Fondo’ attack animation when performing that attack after doing a ‘Piercing Retribution.
[*] Verdadera Destreza damage bonus now deals a mix of Lightning and Piercing damage. For most attacks, total damage stays the same.
[*] Damage for attacks that spend VD counters has been increased.
[*] Some of the weapon cancellation windows have been revised to increase responsiveness. This includes the Silver Nail attack.
[/list]

[h2]Ruego Al Alba[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Weight of Sin would rapidly hit multiple times the enemies that it passed through, causing more damage than intended.
[/list]

[h1]Bosses[/h1]

[list]
[*] Bosses can no longer die after the player is killed.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could die upon entering Radames boss room if they crouched.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could die after defeating Benedicta if they crouched.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could die after killing Orospina by falling through one of the holes at the sides of her arena.
[*] Fixed a bug where Orospina could fall through one of the holes at the sides of her arena during one of her attacks.
[*] Fixed a bug where Odón’s soldiers wouldn’t die properly after the boss death.
[*] Fixed a bug where Odón’s chose the Banner move without soldiers present.
[*] Fixed a bug where players could get locked out of Sínodo’s arena.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could attack Svsona before her battle began.
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause a softlock after fighting Svsona.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could attack Infanta before her battle began.
[/list]

[h2]Balance[/h2]

[list]
[*] Mid to late game fights have been rebalanced to improve the difficulty curve.

[list]
[*]Benedicta attack damage and HP has been increased.
[*]Odón’s fight presents the most changes, with several tweaks to improve the challenge expected at that stage of the game. 

[list]
[*]HP and attack damage has been increased, and the boss is now more reactive to player’s actions.
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*]Svsona attack damage and HP has been increased.
[*]Eviterno first phase is now a bit shorter, and his attack damage has been slightly increased.
[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Enemies[/h1]

[list]
[*]Acolyte and Sacrist enemies 

[list]
[*]They now leave a gap between them and walls after their charge attack.
[*]Contact damage issues have been fixed.
[/list]
[*]Esquilon

[list]
[*]Charge attack now knocks the player behind the enemy.
[*]The enemy can now be dashed through during certain animations.
[*]Contact damage issues have been fixed.
[/list]
[*]Censer Spinner 

[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with their attack values being incorrectly assigned.
[/list]
[*]Shielded Giant enemies

[list]
[*]Fixed an issue that caused hits on the weak point to be shielded.
[*]Fixed a visual bug where the Shielded Giant enemies would remain in their attack animation while stunned.
[/list]
[*] Fixed a bug where enemies spawned in arenas would be frozen in time if the player entered the room with a time-stop effect being active.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Stone Hand enemies would not move.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Owl Lady enemies would not look at the player when attacked from behind.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Sacred Knight projectiles could vanish mid-cast.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Flamethrower enemies could cause performance issues.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Stone Head enemy’s projectiles would slow down when moving down a ramp.
[*] Fixed a bug where some enemies would appear behind chests instead of in front of them.
[*] Fixed a bug where some enemy arenas would cause issues if the enemies were killed after the player had already died.
[*] Fixed a bug where some enemy projectiles would spawn with their hitboxes disabled.
[*] Fixed a visual bug where some enemies could still fly up and down with a time-stop effect being active.
[*] Fixed a visual bug where some enemies executions would be shown incorrectly.
[*] Fixed a visual bug where the Walking Statues enemies could die without breaking their shield.
[*] Improved the player’s feedback when parrying a Chandelier projectile.
[*] Improved the Flying Hand enemy behavior and projectile.
[*] Combat arenas: Added new enemy spawn effects, easier to notice and slightly longer.
[/list]

[h1]Items[/h1]

[h2]Prayers[/h2]

[list]
[*] Some prayers that stay active during a period of time now feature a penalty to fervour gain while the effect is active.
[*] Bleeding Crown

[list]
[*]Reduced damage from 34 to 24 Mystic damage per tick.
[/list]

[*] Seguiriya to the Memory of your Eyes

[list]
[*]Reduced active time from 6s to 3.5s
[*]Fixed a bug that caused some projectiles to keep moving during the prayer’s effects.
[/list]

[*] Jabera To The Poison of Jealousy

[list]
[*]Several changes, including new graphic, damage tweaks and improved behavior.
[/list]

[*] Mirabras of the Return to Port

[list]
[*]Fixed a visual bug where the player would have some leftover particles above their head after casting the prayer ‘Mirabras of the Return to Port’.
[*]Fixed a bug where the player could dodge attacks by using the prayer at the right time.
[*]Fixed a few issues concerning the prayer menu.
[*]Fixed a bug that could freeze all elements in that room after using the prayer.
[/list]
[/list]

[h2]Rosary Beads[/h2]

[list]
[*] Elemental Resistance beads could trivialize some of the late parts of the game. To address this, the Resistance bonus values for late game Elemental Resistance beads has been decreased.
[*] Fixed Chisel Engraved Wound rosary mistakenly detecting a secret in Manor of the Embroideries.
[/list]

[h2]Resonances[/h2]

[list]
[*] Slaughter 
[list]
[*]Fervour gain while the effect is active has a 90% reduction.
[/list]
[*] Liquid Time 
[list]
[*]Fervour gain while the effect is active has a 90% reduction.
[*]Effect duration changed from 3 to 2s
[/list]
[*] SpellBlade 
[list]
[*]Now it correctly changes Sarmiento and Centella Verdadera Destreza bonus damage type to Mystic for all their attacks.
[/list]
[*]Second Wind
[list]
[*]Fixed a visual bug where the resonance ‘Second Wind’ would cause the healing effect to show twice when using a healing flask.
[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Achievements[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added a safety measure to ensure that the achievement ‘Blasphemous II’ is properly granted after meeting its unlock condition.
[*] Added a safety measure to ensure that the achievements ‘Still among us’, ‘No Cherub Left Behind’ and ‘Hide and Seek’ are properly granted after meeting their unlock conditions.
[/list]

[h1]UI[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the mouse remained visible on PC.
[*] Fixed a bug where enemies’ lifebars would not be visible in the zone ‘Two Moons’.
[*] Fixed a bug where some in-game windows would not be aligned to the screen.
[*] Fixed a bug where the credits background wouldn’t fill the whole screen.
[*] Added a ToA indicator on some NPC questions that require payment.
[*] Fixed some issues related to the map.
[*] Fixed Weight of Guilt tutorial not appearing if your initial weapon was Ruego Al Alba.
[*] Mouse buttons now fully work when rebinded.
[/list]

[h1]NPCs[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed several issues related with Yerma storyline.
[*] Fixed several minor issues related to NPCs.
[/list]

[h1]Localisation[/h1]

[list]
[*] Multiple text revisions on all languages.
[/list]

[h1]Levels[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where an invisible platform was present in the ‘Crimson Rains’ zone.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could get softlocked in a certain combat arena if the enemies fell from the arena platform.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could get softlocked in a certain combat arena if they teleported there without having activated the Prie-Dieu first.
[*] Fixed a few collision issues.
[*] Fixed the possibility of missing an arena reward if the player was killed at the same time than the last enemy. These missing rewards will spawn in their respective arenas if players were affected by this bug.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a Guilt Fragment to drop inside a small gap in Sacred Entombments.
[*] Fixed a camera issue that happened in Aqueducts of the Costales.
[*] Fixed a camera issue that happened in Crimson Rains
[/list]

[h1]Performance[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused glitches after activating Vsync in certain monitors.
[*] Improved the game’s performance for both console and pc versions.
[/list]

[h3]Once again, thank you for your continuous support.

Sorrowful be the Heart, Penitent Ones.[/h3]

notes.title: Blasphemous II is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]THE TIME FOR ATONEMENT IS NIGH: BLASPHEMOUS 2 IS OUT NOW![/h1]

The Game Kitchen and Team17 Digital have today launched punishing Metroidvania Blasphemous 2 on Steam! Following a newly reawakened Penitent One, Blasphemous 2 thrusts players back into an endless cycle of life, death, and resurrection as they face monstrous enemies and inconceivable challenges to halt the prophetic birth of a new Child of the Miracle.

Featuring three unique weapons to acquire and master, and an enhanced skillset to choose from, players will have to use these new tools to survive and explore a land hell bent on sending them back to the grave as they collect scattered pieces of lore, unpick long forgotten secrets, and avoid deaths final embrace.

[previewyoutube=cdiDP6dHIJs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Blasphemous 2 Key Features[/h3]

[list]
[*] Discover a rich non-linear world: A series of enchantingly grotesque landscapes await, oozing gothic charm and littered with unforgiving traps; there is no wrong turn to take, only scores to settle
[*][b] Unleash savage combat[/b]: Brutal executions and expanded combos provide new and devastating ways to rain destruction on the abominations that await
[*] [b]Play your way[/b]: Blasphemous 2 provides the ability to customise and improve the Penitent Ones’ base skillset, and introduces new unique weapons that expand player tactics
[*] [b]Overcome intense boss battles[/b]: Twisted bosses with unique attack patterns and sundering abilities await in the darkest corners of this twisted new land
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2114740/Blasphemous_2/

notes.title: Blasphemous 2 Revealed
notes.content:
[h3]PENANCE NEVER ENDS AS BLASPHEMOUS 2 IS REVEALED[/h3]

[b]The Penitent One returns for the highly anticipated sequel to The Game Kitchen’s 2019 multi-award-winning action platformer.[/b]

Team17 Digital and The Game Kitchen have premiered the very first look of Blasphemous 2! Coming to Steam later this year, Blasphemous 2 follows The Penitent One as he awakens in an unfamiliar land, displaced from his final resting place, and thrust back into the endless cycle of life, death, and resurrection.

[b]Penance begins anew in this first look at Blasphemous 2:[/b]

[previewyoutube=ReA837m2VgY;full][/previewyoutube]


Set after the events of the original Blasphemous’ 2021 update Wounds of Eventide, Blasphemous 2 sees the return of the supernatural entity The Miracle, leaving The Penitent One no choice but to explore a strange unfamiliar world, defeat the monstrosities that lay in wait, and try to stop the prophetic birth of a new miracle child from coming to pass. Featuring grotesque enemies and titanic bosses clambering to return him to the grave, The Penitent One will need to utilise and master new weapons and an enhanced skillset and try to survive long enough to deliver judgment to those who stand in his way, while unravelling long forgotten secrets.

[*] [b]Play your way[/b]: Blasphemous 2 provides the ability to customise and improve the Penitent Ones’ base skillset, and introduces new unique weapons that expand player tactics
[*] [b]Overcome intense Boss Battles:[/b] Twisted bosses with unique attack patterns and sundering abilities await in the darkest corners of this twisted new land
[/list]
